Title: Login with username "standard_user" and password "secret_sauce"
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter the username and the password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: The "Products" page opens and it shows 6 products.

Title: Login with the locked out user "locked_out_user" and password "secret_sauce"
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter the username and the password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: An error message that says the user has been locked out is shown. The user stays on the login page.

Title: Login with username "standard_user" and the wrong password "wrong_password"
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter the username and the password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: The error "Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

Title: Login with the unknown username "unknown_user" and password "secret_sauce"
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter the username and the password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: The error "Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

Title: Login with an empty username and password "secret_sauce"
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Leave the username empty and enter the password. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: The error "Username is required" is shown.

Title: Login with username "standard_user" and an empty password
Steps: 1. Open the login page. 2. Enter the username and leave the password empty. 3. Click Login.
Expected Result: The error "Password is required" is shown.
